title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-07-16
lineage: SBD -> Reel Master (10 Inch Reels @ 15ips 1/2trk) -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD -> EAC -> SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the July 16 1966 Fillmore show, highlighted by a blistering Good‑Morning‑Little‑School‑Girl and vivid Pigpen organ jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean Charlie Miller sound‑board transfer that delivers crisp clarity, a prominent organ mix and only a slight imbalance with Jerry’s guitar sitting a bit low. Musically the set is celebrated for its early‑Dead energy – GMLSG, "Pain In My Heart", Pigpen’s organ showcases and an inspiring second‑set flow that fans describe as “bubble‑gum” fun. Overall the performance feels like a snapshot of the band at their 1966 breakthrough.

ai_rating.rationale: The overwhelming majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both the performance and the mix; only minor mix‑balance comments appear, yielding an average rating near 4.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Charlie Miller’s transfer is praised as crisp and clear with organ front‑and‑center; vocals are panned left, instruments right. The only noted issue is Jerry’s guitar being a bit low in the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe a fun, “bubble‑gum” feel with a solid first set and a particularly crisp second set that keeps the audience engaged throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is strong but noted as slightly low in the mix; praised as "the strongest player" and referenced with his signature Starfire tone.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is highlighted as outstanding, clear, and a defining element of the performance.
